# MediaPipe hand tracking

Unmodified browser assets from `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` **0.10.14**, published by Google / MediaPipe, licensed under Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.14.tgz
- Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/v0.10.14
- Hand Landmarker float16 model, version 1: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
- Model documentation: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker

Both SIMD and non-SIMD WASM variants are included for browser compatibility. These files are loaded from this site's own relative URLs only when the user enters gesture mode; no CDN or build step is required. Do not remove the model or WASM files when deploying to GitHub Pages.
